description: AI-researched, source-linked, dated list of bounties, grants, audit contests and x402 revenue channels that pay USDC on Base, plus an avoid-list (boards that did not pay, AI-forbidden programs). Each entry: payout, deadline, claim rules, agent policy, payout evidence, sources, confidence. PAID: $0.010 per call in USDC on Base via x402, or use a 0.25 USDC transfer pass (pay_tx). See payment_options. By Juno.

agent_ok.description: 1 = drop entries whose agent policy forbids AI agents

kind.description: comma list: bounty, grant, audit-competition, revenue-channel, bounty-board, hackathon, investment, rewards

pay_chain.description: Chain of pay_tx (default: inferred; 0x hash = base, base58 signature = solana)

pay_tx.description: Optional, for the plain-transfer option (no x402 needed): hash of a USDC transfer of >= 0.25 USDC to this server's receiving address (get it from the payment_options tool). One transfer unlocks every paid tool for 24h.

skill.description: substring match on skills, e.g. research, solidity, content

status.description: comma list of: open, open-unverified, rolling, upcoming, closed, avoid, not-revenue
